'''BolaBar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
BolaBar worked as a poacher. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorite]] crashed onto the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dorumaa]] and awoke a [[Dorumaan leviathan]], a type of giant sea creature. BolaBar and some other poachers planned to kill the creature and then loot ivory from its corpse. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], attempted to save the leviathan, by attacking the poachers. BolaBar and three other poachers tried to fight the Heroes, while the poachers [[Harkaan]] and [[Pardo]] attacked the leviathan with a submersible. However, the Heroes eventually defeated the poachers and saved the leviathan.
